name: print-social-drive-in-cinema-posts-retro-teal-pink-yellow-car-illustration
title: Drive-in cinema pack in teal, pink and yellow with retro car illustrations and popcorn boxes
whatItIs: Nine dark teal square posts with retro flat illustrations of a pink vintage car facing a giant cinema screen shape, black boxed headlines ('Enjoy the Best Premieres in Our Drive-In Cinema', 'Coming Soon in Our Cinema'), a movie ticket icon, popcorn box and drink illustrations, and a small 'THE CINEMA' logo.
whatItMeans: Nostalgic and fun; the vintage car and screen silhouette instantly evoke classic American drive-in culture.
techniques: Illustrate a vintage car facing an implied cinema screen shape.
Box headlines in black for a retro marquee feel.
Add themed props (popcorn, tickets) as supporting icons.

vocabulary.definition: A boxed headline evoking a cinema sign.
Flat art styled after mid-century advertising.
